headline: SFG @ ARI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SFG 4.51 at ARI 4.70, with a projected total of 9.20. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SFG: SFG moved +0.76 runs while ARI moved -0.01, changing the projected margin by +0.77 runs. The projected total climbed +0.74, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -16.2%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Tyler Mahle has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Willy Adames, Corbin Carroll, Rafael Devers, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Drew Gilbert, Adrian Del Castillo because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
